newsitem.title: USA: Foster sees '97 earnings below growth goal.
newsitem.headline: Foster sees '97 earnings below growth goal.

text.p: Foster Wheeler Corp said Monday that it expects 1997 revenues and earnings to increase from 1996 figures, but that it does not expect 1997 earnings to meet its 15 percent annual growth objective.

The company said it expects only modest growth in 1997 earnings from its Energy Equipment Group, which makes industrial boilers and steam generators. While group bookings are at record levels this year, 1997 revenue growth would be lower, the company said.
The company said, however, that the group has a record backlog and that as these contracts are fulfilled, the group should achieve strong earnings in 1998 and beyond.
Last week the company reported third quarter earnings of $0.59 per share and year-to-date earnings of $1.79 per share.
